#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long ones[17];

long long dfs(long long n, int idx){
    long long quot = n / ones[idx];
    n %= ones[idx];
    long long onesUsedHere = quot * idx;
    if(n == 0) return onesUsedHere;
    else
        return onesUsedHere + min(dfs(n, idx - 1),
                    idx + dfs(ones[idx] - n, idx - 1));
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    for(int i = 1; i < 17; ++i){
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1;
    }
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    long long ans = dfs(n, 16);
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
